units.source_text: 后来雷声停息，雨势渐小。

en.t: Afterward the thunder stopped, and the rain gradually eased.

units.source_text: 右大臣便走到这边来看视，先到弘徽殿太后室中。

en.t: The Minister of the Right then came over to see how things were, first going to the Empress Dowager's room in the Kokiden.

units.source_text: 阵雨之声掩没了他的行动声，源氏大将和胧月夜并未听到。

en.t: The sound of the passing shower covered the noise of his movements, so General Genji and Oborozukiyo did not hear him.

units.source_text: 岂知右大臣贸然地走进室内来了。

en.t: Before they knew it, the Minister of the Right had rashly walked into the room.

units.source_text: 他撩起帘子，开口便问：“你怎么样？

en.t: He lifted the curtain and immediately asked, "How are you?

units.source_text: 昨夜的雷雨好厉害，我很担心，但未能来看你。

en.t: Last night's thunderstorm was terrible, and I was very worried, but I could not come to see you.

units.source_text: 你哥哥和太后的侍臣等有没有来探望你？”

en.t: Did your elder brother and the Empress Dowager's attendants come to visit you?"

units.source_text: 他说时快嘴快舌，粗声粗气，全不像个贵人。

en.t: He spoke rapidly and bluntly, in a rough voice, not at all like a nobleman.

units.source_text: 源氏大将虽在困窘之中，想起了左大臣的威仪，和这右大臣比较一下，不禁微笑起来。

en.t: Though General Genji was in an awkward position, he thought of the dignity of the Minister of the Left, compared him with this Minister of the Right, and could not help smiling.

units.source_text: 不要在帘外伸头探脑，规规矩矩走进室内以后再开口说话才是。

en.t: One ought not poke one's head around outside the curtain, but should properly enter the room before speaking.
